name: MySQL
shortDescription: PowerDNS-Admin web interface for PowerDNS zones and records, backed by a bundled MySQL 8.4 database.

alerts.message: The first account registered becomes the administrator. Register it right after deployment, then turn off sign-ups under Settings > Authentication if you do not want open registration.
This deploys the web interface only. Enable the HTTP API on your PowerDNS Authoritative Server and enter its API URL and key under Settings > Server; the server must be reachable from this app.
